model.ansatz: independent RY/RZ plus nearest-neighbor CNOT chain
model.classifier_readout: Pauli-Z expectations on qubits 0 and 1 plus softmax
model.candidate_measurement_scope: same-axis Pauli products on the two readout qubits; ZZ/XX/YY is not tomographically complete
model.readout_qfi_reference: SLD QFI of the two-readout-qubit reduced density matrix; an upper bound for that subsystem, not a jointly attainable multiparameter CFI
model.learned_measurement_class: local fixed-spectrum projective axes on each readout qubit, with joint bitstring outcomes

training.selection_policy: inherits E008 train-only classifier/lambda and E010 EWC-DR relevance; measurement hyperparameters are prespecified for the seed-42 development run

measurement_design.fisher_parameter: classifier weights theta, not measurement axes phi

objective_variants.info_learn_basis_alloc: uniform relevance; learned axes and allocation
objective_variants.task_learn_basis_uniform: EWC-DR relevance; learned axes; uniform allocation
objective_variants.task_learn_basis_alloc: EWC-DR relevance; learned axes and allocation

measurement_design.initialization: Z/X/Y product axes plus deterministic small noise
measurement_design.optimizer: analytic-gradient local tangent trust regions with sphere retraction and physical-gradient stopping; certified convex q solve alternated afterward
